items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1996-01-10
items.q: And this is how I got involved with a lot of people. You take friends like over in Appaloosias, Louisiana, we had a fellow by the name of Mason who probably had the largest black hotel ever in the history of Appaloosias. And a lot of people thought it was Louis Mason. But this guy's name, his first

ctx.x: And other businesses started developing around the area, so they brought a lot of money there. And so they had many good times there. And when I think about old Al Smith and Arthur Butte and Bill Kale and all those guys, and then it was Sergeant Henry Jett, who was the right-hand man to Lieutenant Flowers. I used to meet up with those guys on the main thoroughfare in Lake Charles. We used to have a lot of fun. And I used to get a lot of information from them whenever I would write a column.
